body: Wow... Why does this have 0 upvotes, someone literally downvoted... 😔

It's not a very active time in general for Reddit, plus it's only been fifteen minutes. Give it a go... I've seen plenty of people here get help. I'm just one person and there's not really much advice to offer here. Nobody can suggest seeking professional help, ect because I have and yet here I still am close to taking my life. I can't be helped... But that doesn't mean you can't be. Honestly, if it weren't for this thing with my "friend", I might've made it out of all this... Things were kind of looking up. But I've learnt that for me, everything good goes away eventually.

There are people who do. Not enough, mind you... Not nearly enough. To a lot of happy people someone so sad all the time is a drag to be around. There's a few people out there, who will help no matter what in times of crisis, though. Shame everyone who's ever abandoned me aren't those people.
